item.title: Off the Shelf: Powerful women, powerful reads
item.description: Weeks of packing and moving have led to the final stages of setup at the Sequim Library’s new building at 630 N. Sequim Ave. We are preparing to open our doors in mid-March, after the certificate of occupancy is finalized by the City of Sequim and Hoch Construction.

item.title: Three OMC nurses honored with Daisy Award
item.description: Olympic Medical Center has honored three registered nurses with the Daisy Award for Extraordinary Nursing. The honorees are oncology nurse Lisa Connoly-Petrisin, medical/surgical/pediatrics nurse Marie Flanagan, and emergency department nurse Josh Sund.
